mdMessage.motto: Remind you – Quality is our way of life and we shall commit to remain so!
paragraphs: It is the endeavor of Reva Phoenix Labs & Consultants Pvt. Ltd. Consulting Division to add value to our Customer's Business & Management Systems through Training, Consultation, Implementation and other Value-added services.
It has been nearly 2 decades since we started Reva Phoenix, as a modest organization. We have grown to become one of the leading service providers in the Industry.
Our growth is attributed to the blessings of Smt. Revathi Venkatesan, Our Founder Director, Cancer warrior & Survivor and the inspiration behind this Organization;

Our unwavering focus to learning and advancement of our knowledge, sharing them with our Customers, operational performance, and the value-added sessions that we deliver to our clients. In our ever-changing and challenging world of business, we are committed to keeping our Engineers, Trainers & Consultants in a leadership position in our chosen areas of work.

We continue to live the mission we started in 2005, and we have stayed the course. Using tough benchmarks, Reva Phoenix has delivered great results that have been sustained for years, and has provided new standards for others consulting agencies & our competitors to follow.

Every day, we make productive contributions to Management Systems, across various Sectors and Industries, through our services in QMS, EMS, OHSAS, NDT, TPI & related Business Excellence services through talent, real-world knowledge, and the capability to implement and fulfill our promise.
As an Organization, we work together organizing our resources to develop ways to advance performance.
We value and focus on quality measures as a commitment to integrity and quality.
Our pledge at Reva Phoenix is to deliver the best Quality services and to continue to advance our offerings so that our Customers can reach their highest potential.
We at Reva Phoenix realize that performance isn't the only measure, because at the end of the day, the outcome of our client & his business success is what really matters.

businessExcellence.desc: Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain, Safety – establishing world-class visual shop floors.
businessExcellence.name: 5S / 6S Workplace Organization

pillars.text: Identify essential vs non-essential items using systematic red-tag campaigns. Eliminate scrap, obsolete tooling, and excess WIP from shop floors.
pillars.title: 1S – Seiri (Sort)

pillars.text: Establish a designated place for everything and everything in its place. Implement shadow boards, visual floor striping, color-coded boundaries, and ergonomic tool placements.
pillars.title: 2S – Seiton (Set In Order)

pillars.text: Clean and inspect machinery during cleaning. Identify root causes of leaks, dust, and contamination, turning daily cleaning into preventative maintenance inspection.
pillars.title: 3S – Seiso (Shine)

pillars.text: Create visual standard operating procedures (SOPs), 5S schedules, color-coding standards, and clear ownership matrices across shifts.
pillars.title: 4S – Seiketsu (Standardize)

pillars.text: Establish daily gemba walks, tiered audit scorecards, visual 5S radar charts, and recognition programs to cement long-term operational habits.
pillars.title: 5S – Shitsuke (Sustain)

pillars.text: Embed proactive hazard identification, emergency egress clearance, PPE demarcation, and ergonomics into every daily operational routine.
pillars.title: 6S – Safety (The 6th S)

businessExcellence.overview: Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) is an organization-wide physical asset management strategy focused on maximizing Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) while striving for zero unplanned breakdowns, zero minor stops, and zero defects. Originated by JIPM, TPM empowers operators to take co-ownership of machine health through structured maintenance pillars.
